description_en: Modifies the strict mode configuration to specify whether alerts are enabled in strict mode. This API operation performs a full update
description_zh: 用户修改严格模式配置，选择严格模式下的告警是否打开，该接口为全量接口
name: UpdateStrictEventName

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the language of the request and response. Default value: zh. Valid values:

zh: Chinese.
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为zh。取值：

zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the action to perform on the alerts. Valid values:

on: enables alerts.
off: disables alerts
parameters.help_zh:
操作规则判定操作符：
on：打开告警
off：关闭告警
parameters.name: operator

parameters.help_en:
The list of strict mode alerts to be updated. This is a full list. Strict mode alerts not included in this list will be subjected to the opposite operation.
You can call [DescribeStrictEventName](~~DescribeStrictEventName~~) to obtain the list of all strict mode alerts.
-
parameters.help_zh:
需要操作的严格告警列表，该列表为全量列表，列表未包含的严格告警将执行此次的相反操作。
您可以调用[DescribeStrictEventName](~~DescribeStrictEventName~~)获取所有严格模式的告警列表。
-
parameters.name: event_name_list

parameters.help_zh:
资源目录成员账号ID（阿里云账号）。
调用[DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: resource_directory_account_id

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. This is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used for troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
